headline_marked: [[Next-Concept Modeling shifts AI text generation]] to hierarchical refinement, moving beyond token-by-token methods
headline: Next-Concept Modeling shifts AI text generation to hierarchical refinement, moving beyond token-by-token methods
summary: Stanford researchers introduce Next-Concept Modeling (NCM), a new AI architecture that generates text by building abstract structures first, then refining details in parallel, rather than sequentially.
details: Next-Concept Modeling (NCM), developed by Hazy Research at Stanford University, proposes a new way for AI models to generate text. Unlike traditional autoregressive LLMs that produce one token after another, NCM constructs a hierarchical representation.
The model first generates a global, abstract structure of the response. It then progressively refines these details in parallel, reducing the number of sequential generation steps required.

This approach differs from masked diffusion models, which update multiple tokens simultaneously but may require repeated evaluations over the entire sequence. NCM uses a multiscale hierarchy of discrete codes.

NCM predicts all codes within a given level simultaneously, conditioning subsequent levels on previous representations. This allows for parallelism within each level while maintaining sequential dependencies between levels.

The system utilizes a Multiscale Residual Vector Quantized Variational Autoencoder (VQ-VAE variant) to compress and reconstruct text using discrete representations at different scales. These "concepts" are learned latent representations, not human-interpretable semantic concepts.

The research, published in October 2026, builds on decades of work in probabilistic models, autoencoders, distributed representations, and the Transformer architecture. It also draws inspiration from Visual Autoregressive Modeling (VAR) and diffusion language models.

It's important to note that these initial results do not establish proven performance advantages over existing commercial and open-weight LLMs like GPT, Qwen, or Llama. NCM represents a foundational architectural shift.

headline_marked: [[Meta HQ Targeted]] by Lula Supporters Over Alleged Electoral Interference
headline: Meta HQ Targeted by Lula Supporters Over Alleged Electoral Interference
summary: Protesters gathered outside Meta's São Paulo offices, accusing the tech giant of interfering in Brazil's elections.
details: Supporters of Brazilian President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva staged a protest at Meta's headquarters in São Paulo on Monday.
The demonstrators voiced accusations against the tech giant, alleging that Meta engaged in 'electoral interference'.
The protest occurred outside the company's offices, with banners and signs visible in the crowd.
The specific nature of the alleged interference was not detailed in the provided information, but the sentiment was clearly directed at Meta's role in the electoral process.
